title: qec-vqe: Hardware-Aware Quantum Error Correction and Noise Mitigation for NISQ-Era VQE
description: A tested Python framework (49 unit tests) for controlled bias–variance comparison of quantum error-mitigation stacks — zero-noise extrapolation (noise-rate scaling and unitary folding), readout-mitigation via calibration-matrix inversion — and repetition-code quantum error correction, in NISQ-era variational quantum eigensolver simulations. Includes H2/LiH molecular Hamiltonians, UCCSD and hardware-efficient ansätze, device-calibrated asymmetric noise models, and a fully reproducible benchmark suite regenerating all figures of the accompanying research manuscript (paper/research_paper.md) from a single command.
